English: Scroll Stand
A simple wooden stand for scrolls, serving as the first foundation for learning and administration in the clan.
Scribes Desk
A small workspace for a scribe, allowing the recording of vital clan matters and improving organization.
Reading Pavilion
A sturdy tented area for study, where elders and youth gather to read, debate, and learn together.
Copyists Room
A dedicated shelter for several copyists, producing records, contracts, and teaching materials for the clan.
Book Nook
A well-built, portable shelter filled with precious books and scrolls, encouraging literacy among the clan.
Manuscript Hall
A grand tented hall for storing and producing manuscripts, attracting wise men and teachers from afar.
Archive Chamber
A fortified, mobile archive wagon or yurt, safeguarding the clans vital records and ancestral wisdom.
Scholars Study
A dedicated study-tent for the clans wisest, allowing advanced research, debate, and planning for the future.
Israelite Scriptorium
A legendary center for Israelite scholarship and preservation, renowned for producing masterworks and unifying the clan in faith and wisdom.
Library Hall
A grand and semi-permanent mobile library, housing rare texts and serving as a beacon for scholars across the steppe.
